chose: Each kind's about line is built on the phone from what home was told (ref and fields) through one port per kind: a bite says its game (by home's or the build's name, else "A game on <day>"), the clock part of its strip and its scenario's name; a week's take says "Week N" and its question or ticket; the rest say their ref in words. What a take is about that others share (a game, a week, a session file) is its topic, the key of the about filter and the by-what-it's-about sort.
options: ports on the phone over ref and fields
home's read sends a ready-made about line per take
only home's read names a take; the phone shows the ref
gray: The words on every row are what the owner reads to find a take again, and whether the phone or home words them is not settled by any check or decision.
undo: Edit ABOUT_PORTS in kinds.ts; a home about can take over in aboutWith in components/take-library.
